{{Quote|Albathius, a human who showed up a few years ago. Voss called him the "Shining Man".|Bas-Ton|<ref name="The Prophecy of the Shining Man">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|The Prophecy of the Shining Man|Voss}}</ref>}}
'''Albathius''',<ref>{{TORcite|type=codex|Legend of the Shining Man (Agent)}}</ref> also known as '''The Shining Man''', was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] operative of the [[Star Cabal]]. He arrived on [[Voss]] around [[3645 BBY]], and gained great influence among [[Voss Mystics]], convincing the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] to stay neutral from the war between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] for three thousand days, enough time for the Star Cabal to exert its own influence on the war and keeping the Voss from choosing a side. He promised that in time, the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]], Empire and Republic would be eradicated, and no offworlders would come to Voss. He was buried under [[Voss-Ka]] after his [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="The Prophecy of the Shining Man" />
